provenance.method: Clipped to the extent of the 40 neighborhoods' 77 zips and the eight bases plus 0.12°; area water (MTFCC H2030, H2040, H2051, H2053, at least 400,000 m²) cut from the land; zips and bases clipped to that land, and the land split into the zips plus the rest so they share one coastline; county line = San Diego County's inland boundary; Mexico = Natural Earth's Mexico grown by 0.004° and cut back to Census's border; routes dissolved by name. Simplified with mapshaper@0.7.80 (snap, weighted Visvalingam, keep-shapes) at two levels: detail 60 m for polygons and 120 m for roads; overview 250 m for polygons and 400 m for roads; TopoJSON quantized to 1e5.
